title.en: Turn Hand Sketch into a Flowchart
title.zh: 手绘草图转专业流程图

prompt.en: @handdrawing-sketches.jpg convert this sketch into a professional business process flowchart, strictly preserving its original content and layout.
prompt.zh: @handdrawing-sketches.jpg 把这张手绘草图转换成专业的业务流程图，严格保留原始内容和布局。

reply.en: Redrew the hand sketch as a clean, professional flowchart, preserving the original 3-step structure, all labels, and layout.
reply.zh: 已将手绘草图重绘为清晰、专业的流程图，保留了原有的三步结构、所有文字标注和布局。

caption.en: Professional flowchart redrawn from the hand sketch
caption.zh: 根据手绘草图重绘的专业流程图
